{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000037YB0SP6BYGT6","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
node Person "Person"
node Agent "Agent" right-of Person ref="packages/core/compute/assistant/src/types/Agent.ts"
node Trigger "Trigger" right-of Agent ref="packages/core/compute/compute/src/types/Trigger.ts"
node Manager "Process manager" below Agent ref="packages/core/compute/compute-runtime/src/UnifiedProcessManager.ts"
group local "App" {
  node Local "Local process" ref="packages/core/compute/compute-runtime/src/ProcessManager.ts"
}
group cloud "EDGE" same-row local {
  node Remote "Remote process" ref="packages/core/compute/compute-runtime/src/RemoteProcessManager.ts"
}
node Objects "ECHO objects" below Local
node Trace "Trace feed" right-of Objects ref="packages/core/compute/compute-runtime/src/FeedTraceSink.ts"
edge Person, Agent, Trigger -> Manager bus
edge Manager -> Local
edge Manager -> Remote
edge Local -> Objects
edge Remote -> Objects
edge Local -> Trace
edge Remote -> Trace
"},"objects":[
